name: Mikaze Ai
source:
The senior of Natsuki Shinomiya and Sho Kurusu. He's a hardworking idol who serves as mediator between Ranmaru and Camus when they fight. He is very strict when it comes to his teaching, his previous students quitted after one month of training under him. He plays the synthesizer.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uta_no_Prince-sama]Wikipedia[/url]]
